questions.prompt: A tool_result handler throws an error while masking emails. What does the model receive?
options: Nothing, because pi blocks the result
The original, unmasked result, and pi reports an extension error
An empty result with the error flag set
A result with every field replaced by [email]
questions.explanation: A handler that throws does not block the result. pi reports an extension error and lets the original through, so you must test the rewrite.

questions.prompt: Two tool_result handlers run on one result. What does the second handler see?
options: The original result from the tool
Only the fields the first handler left out
The result with the first handler's changes applied
questions.explanation: Handlers chain. Each one sees the changes made by the handler before it.

questions.prompt: The example handler returns only a new content field. What happens to the details field?
options: It stays as it was, so your own code can still read the full rows
It is deleted, because every field must be returned
It is copied into the content
It is sent to the model in place of the content
questions.explanation: A handler returns only the fields it wants to change. A field it leaves out stays unchanged.
